title: Real-Time Bitcoin Data Explorer
description_html: Explore real-time Bitcoin price data with interactive visualizations and time series analysis.

bitcoin_prices.description: Historical Bitcoin price data with timestamps and market information.

time_series_analysis.description: Precomputed time series analysis results for Bitcoin prices.

recent_prices.sql: SELECT * FROM bitcoin_prices ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 100
recent_prices.title: Recent Bitcoin Prices

daily_average.sql: SELECT DATE(timestamp) as date, AVG(price) as average_price FROM bitcoin_prices GROUP BY DATE(timestamp)
daily_average.title: Daily Average Price

highest_price_per_day.sql: SELECT DATE(timestamp) as date, MAX(price) as max_price FROM bitcoin_prices GROUP BY DATE(timestamp)
highest_price_per_day.title: Highest Price Per Day
